note: City of Floodwood campground on the St. Louis River at the edge of town, a few blocks' walk from the main street; renovated with wider roads, new pads and pedestals. Accessible fishing pier with a fish-cleaning station; public boat landing on Railroad Street. --Claude
summary: City page + its Hipcamp listing: 14 sites, all water + electric (30/50 A), vehicles under 40 ft (site 1 under 30), showers/flush/water/dump; $40 a night on Hipcamp (2026), host books direct to avoid fees; 18-month window. Season not posted. Not waterfront kept; sites 3-9 marketed 'river side' behind a wooded bank: possible riverview. Pin ~120 m east of the loop: optional move.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept; possible riverview): Hipcamp calls sites 3-9 'river side'. The St. Louis River here is ~100 m wide (riverfront class). On imagery the campground road loops ~30-40 m south of the bank (around 46.9302,-92.9095 to 46.9300,-92.9085) with a continuous band of trees between the road and the water; no open ground to the river. That earns at most a filtered riverview, and site positions cannot be placed (no site map). Imagery may predate the renovation (roads widened). Reviewer may upgrade to riverview if listing photos show the river from the riverside pads.

Hookups: Hipcamp's header says 'Electrical, water, and sewage hookups are available at select sites', but the city says every site has water and electric and no per-site listing shows sewer. Sewer not written.
Season: not posted by the city or on Hipcamp (a review dated October 2026). Left absent.
Pin 46.92980,-92.90820 sits in trees east of the fishing pier beside houses, ~120 m east of the campground loop (centre ~46.9300,-92.9097). Under 250 m; optional move to 46.9300,-92.9097.

Phone: stored 218-476-2751 (city hall, posted) OK. The city page also posts the camp host's line 325-253-7538 for campground questions and direct bookings; reviewer may prefer it as the campground phone.
Public (city-owned and operated), so the private price/presence screens do not apply; $40 would pass in any case. Hipcamp shows 91% recommend from 220 reviews.
